== Biography ==

=== 2017 Season ===
Trần '''Kiaya''' Duy Sang joined [[E.Hub United]] as a trainee top laner, as both [[Taurus]] and [[Keiko]] played top lane for the team '''Kiaya''' did not play a game for the team. As [[E.Hub United]] finished fourth in the [[VCS A/2017 Season/Summer Playoffs|Summer Playoffs]]

=== 2018 Season ===

'''Kiaya''' joined [[Ultimate]], who had defeated his previous team in the [[VCS A/2017 Season/Spring Playoffs]], again he joined as a trainee top laner and he did not play a game for the team as [[Ultimate]] finished 2nd in the domestic league, and lost to [[GIGABYTE Marines]] in playoffs to finish 3rd. 

'''Kiaya''' continued the trend of joining a team that defeated his previous team in playoffs by joining [[GAM Esports]] in the regions largest roster change with Eighteen roster changes in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Season]] alone, with the large roster instability Kiaya shared time with [[Blazes]] and [[Calm (Đinh Trọng Quyết)|Calm]] and played seventeen games domestically and four games at [[Rift Rivals 2018/LCL-TCL-VCS|Rift Rivals]],where he mostly playing carries such as Ryze and Kennen.

The Split would be disappointing for [[GAM Esports]], finishing 3rd at [[Rift Rivals 2018/LCL-TCL-VCS|Rift Rivals]] and missing the playoffs of VCS finishing 5th in the [[VCS/2018 Season/Summer Season]] 

=== 2019 Season ===
Due to the disappointment of the Summer Season [[GAM Esports]] would again make widescale changes, VCS rookie Top laner [[Yoshino]] joined the team. However, [[Calm (Đinh Trọng Quyết)|Calm]] and [[Blazes]] would only play Mid lane. Therefore '''Kiaya''' played all but three games in the [[VCS/2019_Season/Spring_Season|VCS Spring Season]], however the team would finish 5th again.

After a second failure to make playoffs [[GAM Esports]] again made large roster changes, acquiring [[Zeros]] and making '''Kiaya''' roleswap to mid lane, '''Kiaya''' would again play most games of [[GAM Esports|GAM Esports']] 1st place finish in the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Season|Summer Season]] and unbeaten run in the [[VCS/2019 Season/Summer Playoffs|Playoffs]].

At the [[2019 Season World Championship]] Despite being in a difficult group including eventual winners [[FunPlus Phoenix|FPX]] Kiaya would make one of the highlight plays of the tournament, using Kled to solokill [[J-Team|J-Teams's]] [[FoFo|FoFo's]] Lucian in the teams only win of the tournament. Where he would achieve a 5/1/10 scorline. 

=== 2020 Season ===
As both [[Zeros]] and [[Yoshino]] left the team and while despite [[Zeros]] returning due to the [[2019–20_Coronavirus_Pandemic]], [[Kiaya]] returned to toplane and would play most games in [[GAM Esports]] domination of the split, finishing 1st and only losing one series. The team had a 27-5 and Kiaya had an record of 20-4 and only losing more than one game to [[Yoshino|Yoshino's]] [[Team Flash.Vietnam|Team Flash]].

Due to the teams domination, and [[Yoshino]] being unable to play due to illness [[GAM Esports]] was expected to win the [[VCS/2020 Season/Spring Playoffs|Spring Playoffs]], however after GAM became 2-1 behind after [[Kiaya]] performed poorly with a 1/5/5 KDA he would be substituted out and the team would lose Game 5 despite having a 5.6k gold lead at 18 minutes.

== Trivia ==
*Consistently maintains Challenger on the Korean server.
*He was awarded the title of National Sports Master by the Ministry of Sports, Culture and Tourism of Vietnam after winning the Gold Medal with the [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at the [[Sea Games 31|31st SEA Games]] at the end of 2022.
*He was awarded the title of National Esports Grandmaster by VIRESA (Vietnam Esports Federation) after achieving good results with [[GAM Esports]] at [[2023_Season_World_Championship|Worlds 2023]] and with [[Vietnam (National Team)|Vietnam National Team]] at [[2022 Asian Games]]  on January 21, 2024.
*He was nominated and won "ZFace - Gương mặt GenZ nổi bật (Outstanding GenZ Face)" category of the major annual award WeChoice Award.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hBNEK-6Z_SU  GALA VINH DANH VÀ TRAO GIẢI WECHOICE AWARDS 2023]</ref>
